nodes.description: ERC20 token contract being held by the TokenTimelock
Address of the beneficiary that receives tokens after release
Timestamp when token release becomes enabled
Constructor of TokenTimelock that validates releaseTime against block.timestamp and stores token, beneficiary and releaseTime
View getter returning the held token
View getter returning the release time
Transfers all held tokens to the beneficiary once the release time has passed
Constructor of CATXTimeLock that forwards token, beneficiary and releaseTime to the TokenTimelock base constructor
Block timestamp used for time-based release checks
SafeERC20 external token transfer that hands control to the token contract and transfers funds to the beneficiary
Constructor parameter for the ERC20 token address
Constructor parameter for the beneficiary address
Constructor parameter for the release timestamp
Local variable holding the token balance to be released

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token is assigned to the _token state variable
Constructor parameter beneficiary is assigned to the _beneficiary state variable
Constructor parameter releaseTime is assigned to the _releaseTime state variable
Constructor requires releaseTime > block.timestamp, making it dependent on miner-controllable timestamp
release() requires block.timestamp >= _releaseTime, a timestamp dependency gating the release
release() reads the _releaseTime state variable to gate the transfer
Local variable amount is set from _token.balanceOf(address(this))
The _token state variable is used as the target of the safeTransfer operation
The local amount variable is passed as the value to safeTransfer
The beneficiary that receives the external token transfer is an attacker-influenceable recipient
release() performs the external safeTransfer call before the transaction completes
The external token transfer hands control to an external contract that could re-enter release()
CATXTimeLock constructor invokes the TokenTimelock base constructor

normalization_plan.reason: The token constructor parameter has no standalone semantic value and should be absorbed into the TokenTimelock constructor that consumes it
The beneficiary constructor parameter only feeds the constructor assignment and should be merged into the TokenTimelock constructor
The releaseTime constructor parameter only feeds the constructor assignment and timestamp check and should be merged into the TokenTimelock constructor
The local amount variable exists only to be passed into the safeTransfer unsafe operation and should be merged into it
